description: This Java class generates example JSON files for policies and authorization contexts, primarily for testing or example purposes within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: PolicyModelJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that produces sample JSON files representing policies and authorization contexts for testing or demonstrations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that takes a directory path argument and initiates the file generation process.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Sets up authorization subjects and context, and initiates the creation of policy JSON files.

methods.name: producePolicyModel
methods.description: Creates a sample policy object with specific permissions and writes it as a JSON file.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Converts a Jsonifiable object to JSON string and writes it to a specified file.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a given string to a specified file path.
